description: A gap behind a stack of pallets where the wall of the bonded store doesn't quite meet the wall of the chem supplier. Dry, out of the wind, and warm along one side where a duct runs through. There is a nest of shredded pallet-wrap here, flattened in the middle, and a small collection of bottle caps that has clearly been curated. No door, no way in, no way out. Nothing with hands has ever been in here.
name: Behind the Pallets
